We have seen the image formed when an object is placed further than 2F from a thin converging lens. One example is the camera. Click on the icons to toggle between the ray diagrams and the summary table.

Let us now take a look at the image formed when the object is placed nearer the lens, at 2F. An example of this is a photocopier when making a duplicate of a document.
